events.name: Inverter AC Under Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension onduleur sous les limites programmées sur une phase.

events.name: Inverter AC Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension onduleur hors limites haute.
events.manual_note: Le texte du manuel décrit une condition de sous-tension pour cet événement : incohérence probable, à confirmer.

events.name: Input AC Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension d'entrée au-dessus des limites. Le redresseur est désactivé et l'UPM passe sur batterie si elle est disponible.

events.name: Input AC Under Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension d'entrée sous les limites. Fonctionnement redresseur, redresseur+batterie ou batterie selon la charge ; charge batterie possiblement coupée.

events.name: Input Under / Over Frequency

events.name: ESS Inverter Gapping
events.desc_en:
Error code:
• 1= Gapping is on
During the first 20 msec of a forward transfer, the inverter monitors the hardware current
limit. If a current limit is detected for 1 msec, the inverter shuts off for a defined period of
time and then turns back on. This creates a gap in the output to help commutate off the
SCRs.
events.desc_fr: Pendant les 20 premières ms d'un transfert direct, l'onduleur se coupe brièvement si la limite de courant matérielle est atteinte, pour aider à bloquer les SCR (création d'un creux dans la sortie).

events.name: Inverter Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Température onduleur trop haute (niveau d'avertissement, aucune action automatique).

events.name: Inverter Fault
events.desc_fr: Défaut matériel de l'onduleur : signal de défaut du gate driver actif.

events.name: Rectifier Input Over Current
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant matérielle du redresseur atteinte plusieurs cycles : redresseur coupé, transfert sur batterie.

events.name: Inverter Output Over Current
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant de sortie onduleur atteinte : onduleur coupé, transfert sur bypass si possible.

events.name: DC Link Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension du bus DC trop haute : convertisseurs coupés, transfert sur bypass si possible.

events.name: DC Link Under Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension du bus DC trop basse : convertisseurs coupés immédiatement.

events.name: Battery Current Over Limit
events.desc_fr: Limite de courant batterie atteinte : chargeur/boost coupé.

events.name: UPM EEPROM Checksum Failed
events.desc_fr: Échec de checksum EEPROM de la carte interface à l'initialisation : démarrage interdit.

events.name: UPM Shutdown imminent
events.desc_fr: Avertissement d'arrêt de la charge imminent (ex. limite DCUV batterie atteinte).

events.name: Low Battery Warning
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie sous le niveau d'alarme batterie faible.

events.name: Utility Not Available
events.desc_fr: Réseau perdu (perte de verrouillage de phase ou tension < 50 % du nominal) : passage sur batterie.

events.name: Rectifier Breaker Open
events.desc_en:
No error code. Set/cleared when the rectifier breaker is opened or closed. This notice
can also mean that one or more rectifier fuses have failed.
This notice is not yet implemented. It is reserved for possible future use.
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur redresseur ouvert (peut aussi signaler un fusible redresseur HS). Réservé, non encore implémenté.

events.name: Battery DC Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie > 2,45 V/élément : chargeur coupé, batterie déconnectée après 60 s.

events.name: Rectifier Phase Rotation
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases d'entrée redresseur inversé.

events.name: UPM Control Power

values.3: Reset was caused by an illegal CPU operation
values.8: Reset was caused by a bad oscillator clock signal

events.timing: N/A set at | N/A | N/A | When
events.desc_en:
This status is logged after processor initialization is complete.
• 0 = Normal power on event
• 3 = Reset was caused by an illegal CPU operation
• 5 = Reset was caused by watchdog
• 8 = Reset was caused by a bad oscillator clock signal
events.desc_fr: Journalisé après l'initialisation du processeur UPM (0 = mise sous tension normale ; 3, 5, 8 = reset anormal).

events.name: Inverter On / Off
events.desc_en: No error code. This event is logged when the inverter is started or stopped.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé au démarrage ou à l'arrêt de l'onduleur.

events.name: UPM Hot
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether UPM inverter output
is energized or not. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not impact
the actual UPM functionality.
events.desc_fr: Indique à la CSB si la sortie onduleur de l'UPM est sous tension ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Battery In Common
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is valid only in a parallel system with 2 or more UPMs. If the
condition is true, all UPMs have a common battery, otherwise each have their own
battery.
events.desc_fr: Valable en parallèle (2 UPM ou plus) : vrai si les UPM partagent une batterie commune.

events.name: Service Battery

bits.1: Chute de tension trop forte au repos
bits.16: Tension de floating non atteinte en 24 h

events.desc_fr: La batterie nécessite une intervention.

events.name: Phase A/B/C Overload
events.desc_fr: Charge au-dessus de la valeur nominale sur la phase concernée (27 = A, 28 = B, 29 = C). Variantes niveau 2 : 30-32 ; niveau 3 : 33-35 ; niveau 4 : 36-38.

events.name: Phase A/B/C Overload Level 2/3/4
events.desc_fr: Dépassement des niveaux de surcharge 2 (30-32), 3 (33-35) ou 4 (36-38). Voir 'Behavioral specification' pour la réponse de l'UPS.

events.name: UPM On Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPM has received a command for load on.
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPM On Command » reçue.

events.name: UPM Off Command
events.desc_en:
• 0 = Standby command
• 1 = Shutdown command
The UPM has received a command for load off (excluding EPO).
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPM Off Command » reçue.

events.name: Charger Off Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPM received a charger off command.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Charger Off Command » reçue.

events.name: Charger On Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPM received a charger on command.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Charger On Command » reçue.

events.name: Low Battery Shutdown
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie sous la limite EEPROM : charge coupée après 3 s.

events.name: UPM Software Incompatible

values.0x001x: ID machine de la carte interface incorrect
values.0x004x: PLD non prévu pour cette interface
values.0x0050: La carte n'est pas un UPM
values.0x0100: Firmware UPM incompatible avec la MCU (non implémenté en 93PM)

events.desc_fr: Firmware ou version PLD incompatible.

events.name: UPM Remote Emergency Power Off
events.desc_fr: EPO distant activé : convertisseurs coupés, charge coupée.

events.name: Battery Test Failed
events.desc_fr: Un test batterie a échoué : tension passée sous la limite.

events.name: Fuse Failed
events.desc_en:
Not implemented. Fuse failure cannot be reliably detected, see JIRA PANPRE-1002 for
details.
events.desc_fr: Défaillance de fusible : NON implémenté (une défaillance de fusible ne peut pas être détectée de façon fiable). Mesurer, ne pas déduire.

events.name: Fan Failed

bits.0x01: Au moins un ventilateur en défaut

events.desc_fr: Rotor bloqué détecté sur un ou plusieurs ventilateurs.

events.name: Site Wiring Fault
events.desc_fr: Tension neutre-terre excessive (défaut de câblage du site).

events.name: Batteries Disconnected
events.desc_fr: Batteries non connectées, aucune tension batterie.

events.name: UPM Selective Trip
events.desc_fr: Déclenchement sélectif d'un UPM en parallèle : défaut onduleur critique, module retiré du système.

events.name: Rectifier Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Température redresseur/boost trop haute (avertissement).

events.name: Configuration Error

bits.0x02: Section FW setup EEPROM réinitialisée : vérification requise
bits.0x04: Section synchronisée interne EEPROM réinitialisée : vérification requise
bits.0x08: Deux UPS en parallèle ont le même numéro, ou numéro mal configuré
bits.0x80: Révision carte de contrôle non supportée
bits.0x1000: Configuration EEP incohérente avec le matériel (EEP 565 'UPMkVA' ; EEP 11 et 5011 sortie monophasée)
bits.0x4000: Tension batterie anormale : nombre de cellules (EEP 302) possiblement incorrect

events.desc_fr: Erreur de configuration. Plusieurs conditions peuvent être actives en même temps (code = somme de bits).

events.name: Precharge Failed

values.x2: Niveau cible du bus DC non atteint
values.24: Fermeture de l'appareillage batterie en échec

error_code.note: x = 1 : précharge redresseur ; x = 2 : précharge démarrage sur batterie

events.desc_fr: La précharge du bus DC a échoué : l'UPS ne peut pas démarrer.

events.name: Rectifier On/ Off
events.desc_en: No error code. The event is logged when the rectifier is turned on or off.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé à la mise en marche ou à l'arrêt du redresseur.

events.name: Charger On/ Off
events.desc_en: No error code. The event is logged when the charger is started or stopped.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé au démarrage ou à l'arrêt du chargeur.

events.name: UPM State Request
events.desc_en:
The UPM state requested by the MCU has changed.
• 1 = Shutdown
• 2 = Standby
• 3 = Online
• 4 = ECT
• 5 = Suspend
• 6 = HRS
• 7 = Energize output (not a "real" UPM state)
• 8 = Suspend rectifier on
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPM State Request » reçue.

events.name: UPM On Battery
events.desc_en: No error code. Load is powered from battery for 5 seconds (hard-coded 5 seconds).
events.desc_fr: La charge est alimentée par la batterie depuis plus de 5 s.

events.name: UPM On Normal
events.desc_en: No error code. If the UPM is online, this alarm is active.
events.desc_fr: L'UPM est en ligne (online).

events.name: Battery Test In Progress
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPM currently is running a battery test (either a battery quick test or
the battery test). See "Battery Management specification" for more information.
events.desc_fr: Un test batterie (rapide ou complet) est en cours.

events.name: Battery Discharging
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether battery is
discharging or not. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not impact
the actual UPM functionality. Triggered by the On Battery node bit. The On Battery node
bit is set when the battery boost converter is on for more than 5 seconds.
events.desc_fr: La batterie se décharge ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Inverter Switchgear Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether the inverter relay is
closed or not. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not impact the
actual UPM functionality.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le relais onduleur est fermé ; sert à l'affichage, sans effet fonctionnel.

events.name: Battery Installed
events.timing: Always true | Always true | Always true | None
events.desc_en: No error code. Indicates whether the battery is installed or not. The status is always true.
events.desc_fr: Indique si la batterie est installée.

events.name: Battery Switchgear Open/ Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code. Set/cleared when the battery relay or a contactor internal to the UPS is
opened or closed.
events.desc_fr: Le relais batterie ou un contacteur interne à l'UPS est ouvert ou fermé.

events.name: Too Many Inverter Transfers
events.desc_fr: Trop de transferts onduleur.

events.name: Rectifier Startup Failure
events.desc_fr: Le redresseur n'a pas démarré après 3 demandes.

events.name: Inverter Switchgear Failed
events.desc_fr: Relais onduleur collé (fermé ou ouvert). Effacé sur commande utilisateur.

events.name: Inverter Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_fr: Radiateur onduleur au-dessus du seuil d'arrêt : onduleur coupé, transfert bypass si possible.

events.name: Rectifier Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_fr: Radiateur redresseur/boost au-dessus du seuil d'arrêt.

events.name: Battery Switchgear Failed

values.1: Relais batterie n'a pas ouvert (> 10 A circule)
values.2: Relais batterie n'a pas fermé (écart > 20 V)

events.desc_fr: Défaut du relais batterie.

events.name: Inverter Overload Trip
events.desc_fr: Transfert bypass ou arrêt dû à une surcharge de sortie.

events.name: 5V / 24V Power Supply Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut d'alimentation logique interne (72 = 5 V, 73 = 24 V).

events.name: Input Sync Out of Range
events.desc_en:
No error code. The input frequency of the UPM has become unqualified for the purposes
of synchronization.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence d'entrée n'est plus qualifiée pour la synchronisation.

events.name: Inverter Startup Failure

values.4: Passage par zéro non trouvé au démarrage à chaud

events.desc_fr: L'onduleur n'a pas démarré.

events.name: SPI Bus Failed

bits.0x0001: EEPROM SPI ou I/O expander en échec au démarrage
bits.0x0004: Bus SPI I/O expander en échec

events.desc_fr: Problème de bus SPI dans le module.

events.name: Rectifier Switchgear Open/ Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code. The unit’s rectifier switchgear is open, signifying that the rectifier is off in
the unit.
events.desc_fr: Appareillage redresseur ouvert : le redresseur est arrêté dans l'unité.

events.name: Loss of Sync Bus
events.desc_en: No error code. Loss of parallel sync signal detected.
events.desc_fr: Perte du signal de synchronisation parallèle.

events.name: Pull Chain
events.desc_en:
No error code. In an internal or external parallel system, indicates that one or more UPSs
has transferred to bypass in the presence of a CAN bus failure. This notice is
suppressed when the CAN bus failure is not active or during the inverter startup state.
The unit transfers to the bypass state when the pull chain is active. See Behavioral
Specification for details.
events.desc_fr: En parallèle, une ou plusieurs UPS ont transféré sur bypass en présence d'un défaut CAN (pull chain active).

events.name: Check Pull Chain
events.desc_fr: Pull chain tirée au niveau bas alors qu'une MCU n'est pas sur bypass, ou flottante au niveau haut alors qu'une MCU est sur bypass.

events.name: UPM Command
events.desc_en:
A new command has been received by the UPM. The command was sent by the MCU.
Command number:
• 1 = Charger on
• 2 = Charger off
• 3 = Start battery test
• 4 = Stop battery test
• 5 = Enable UPM service mode
• 6 = Disable UPM service mode
• 7 = Start UPM test
• 8 = Reset alarms
• 9 = Reset status
• 10 = Test battery converter
• 11 = Trip battery breaker
• 12 = Write EEPROM value
• 13 = Electronic load
• 14 = DR discharge on
• 15 = DR charge on
• 16 = DR off
• 17 = Battery service alarm on
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPM Command » reçue.

events.name: Charger Failed

bits.1: Tension de charge non atteinte dans le temps max (1440 min par défaut)
bits.2: Précharge bus batterie : tension > batterie + 10 V
bits.4: Précharge bus batterie : tension < batterie - 10 V

events.desc_fr: Défaut du chargeur.

events.name: ECT Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPM received an ECT command.
events.desc_fr: Commande « ECT Command » reçue.

events.name: UPM on ECT

values.1: Exit ECT mode when time is over

events.desc_en:
The unit is currently running in the Easy Capacity Test mode. ECTAbandonReason (Bit
field):
• 1 = Exit ECT mode when time is over
events.desc_fr: L'UPM exécute le test de capacité facile (ECT).

events.name: ABM State Charging
events.desc_en:
No error code. The ABM charge mode is charge. See Battery Management specification
for more information.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : charge.

events.name: ABM State Floating
events.desc_en:
No error code. The ABM charge mode is float. See Battery Management specification for
more information.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : floating (maintien).

events.name: ABM State Resting
events.desc_en:
No error code. The ABM charge mode is rest. See Battery Management specification for
more information.
events.desc_fr: Mode ABM : repos.
events.manual_note: Type vide dans le manuel (statut ABM, niveau 1 déduit des statuts ABM voisins 88-89).

events.name: ABM State Reset
events.desc_en:
No error code. ABM is reset. See Battery Management specification for more
information.
events.desc_fr: ABM réinitialisé (ou désactivé par réglage utilisateur).

events.name: Battery Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Température batterie ou convertisseur batterie trop haute.

events.name: Battery Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_fr: Arrêt de la batterie sur température trop haute.

events.name: Ambient Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante de l'UPM trop haute.

events.name: UPM Normal, On ESS Mode
events.desc_en: No error code. The ESS mode is active and the UPM is in suspended mode.
events.desc_fr: Mode ESS actif ; l'UPM est suspendu.

events.name: UPM Normal, On VMMS
events.desc_en: No error code. The VMMS mode is active.
events.desc_fr: Mode VMMS actif.

events.name: UPM in Service Mode
events.desc_en:
The UPM is in service mode.
• 2 = Debugger related
• 3 = ATE related
events.desc_fr: L'UPM est en mode service (2 = débogueur, 3 = ATE).

events.name: Output AC Over Voltage
events.desc_en:
No error code. Output AC over voltage, UPM internal measurement. Normally all UPMs
see the same output voltage, but each UPM also measures the output voltage and uses
it in some situations.
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie au-dessus des limites (mesure interne de l'UPM). En monobloc, le code précise la phase ou la détection rapide.

events.name: Output AC Under Voltage
events.desc_en: No error code. Output AC over voltage, UPM internal measurement.
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie sous les limites (mesure interne de l'UPM). En monobloc, le code précise la phase ou la détection rapide.

events.name: Battery Breaker Open/Closed
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur batterie ouvert (retour contact auxiliaire). Peut être ouvert par l'utilisateur ou par un déclenchement EPO.

events.name: Rectifier Fault
events.desc_fr: Défaut matériel du redresseur : signal de défaut gate driver actif.

events.name: Inverter Matched to Output
events.desc_en:
No error code. This event is activated when output voltage is present and the inverter is
matched to it.
events.desc_fr: La tension de sortie est présente et l'onduleur est synchronisé dessus.

events.name: Too Many Battery Transfers
events.desc_fr: Trop de transferts normal/batterie.

events.name: Battery DC UV Trip Imminent
events.desc_fr: Tension batterie proche de la limite de sous-tension pendant une décharge.

events.name: Battery Startup Failure
events.desc_fr: Le convertisseur batterie n'a pas démarré après 3 demandes.

events.name: Internal CAN Bus Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut du bus CAN interne.

events.name: UPM Unlock
events.desc_en:
No error code. UPM lock off. This is for 93PS hot swap and not implemented in 93PM
yet.
events.desc_fr: Verrouillage de l'UPM levé. Concerne le hot swap 93PS ; non implémenté en 93PM.

events.name: UPM Connection Fail
events.desc_en:
This alarm is active when there is an abnormal connect signal. This is for 93PS hot swap
and not implemented in 93PM yet.
• 1 = Connect detect 1 fail
• 2 = Connect detect 2 fail
• 3 = Connect detect 1 and 2 fail
events.desc_fr: Signal de connexion anormal (hot swap 93PS ; non implémenté en 93PM).

events.name: Pull Out Not Allowed
events.desc_en:
This alarm indicates that there is a load off or safety risk if you pull out the module. A
typical situation is that the system is not redundant. Another situation is that the UPM
hasn’t been shut down. This alarm is for 93PS hot swap and not implemented in 93PM
yet. This alarm is active when both of the following conditions are true:
• UPM Lock Off Alarm is active
• UPM is NOT in shutdown or initialization state
The alarm is cleared when any of the following conditions is true:
• UPM Lock Off Alarm is not active
• UPM is in shutdown state
• UPM is in initialization state
events.desc_fr: Retrait du module interdit : risque de coupure de charge ou de sécurité (hot swap 93PS ; non implémenté en 93PM).

events.name: UPM Critical Parameters Sync In Process
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status being active means that the UPM critical parameter sync is
unfinished, deactivate means that the UPM critical parameter sync is finished.
This nodebit will log only when Hot Swap is enabled (EEP531 is set to 1).
events.desc_fr: Synchronisation des paramètres critiques de l'UPM en cours (journalisé seulement avec hot swap activé, EEP 531 = 1).

events.name: Loss of PWM Sync
events.desc_en:
No error code. This alarm activates when PWM synchronization signal is lost. It is
designed for 93PS to determine the battery boost switching frequency, but also available
for 93PM.
events.desc_fr: Perte du signal de synchronisation PWM (conçu pour le 93PS, disponible en 93PM).

events.name: I2C Bus Failed
events.desc_fr: Problème de bus I2C dans le module.

events.name: Adaptive Overload Capacity Off
events.desc_en:
•   0x0001: Internal CAN error
•   0x0002: HighAmbTemperature
•   0x0004: Battery disconnected
•   0x0008: UPM on battery state
•   0x0010: Fan Failure
events.desc_fr: Capacité de surcharge adaptative désactivée (défaut CAN, température ambiante élevée, batterie déconnectée, fonctionnement sur batterie, défaut ventilateur, ESS...).

events.name: Demand Response Discharge Active
events.desc_en:
No error code. UPM is discharging on a demand response request. Set when UPSaaR
discharge command is executed, cleared when UPSaaR discharge ends.
events.desc_fr: L'UPM se décharge sur demande de réponse à la demande (UPSaaR).

events.name: Demand Response Charge Active
events.desc_en:
No error code. UPM is charging on a demand response request. Set when UPSaaR
charge command is executed, cleared when UPSaaR charge ends.
events.desc_fr: L'UPM se charge sur demande de réponse à la demande (UPSaaR).

events.name: Demand Response Active
events.desc_en: No error code. UPM is in demand response mode.
events.desc_fr: L'UPM est en mode réponse à la demande.

events.name: Demand Response Unavailable
events.desc_en:
•   0x0001: UPM not Online
•   0x0002: Internal CAN error
•   0x0004: Utility not present
•   0x0008: Batteries disconnected
•   0x0010: Battery breaker open
•   0x0020: Battery Switchgear open
•   0x0040: Output overload
•   0x0080: Battery not ready for regulation
•   0x0100: Demand response not enabled
•   0x0200: Battery DCUV imminent
•0x0400: Low battery shutdown
•0x0800: Discharge unavailable due battery
•0x1000: Charge unavailable due battery
UPM demand response unavailable.
events.desc_fr: Réponse à la demande indisponible (bits : UPM pas online, défaut CAN, réseau absent, batteries déconnectées, disjoncteur batterie ouvert, surcharge, batterie non prête...).

events.name: Link to BMS lost
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Liaison avec le BMS perdue.

events.name: Input Relay Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut du relais d'entrée.

events.name: Fan Speed Error
events.desc_fr: Vitesse de ventilateur anormale.

events.name: Private UPM state changed

values.9: UPM in suspended state with rectifier on

events.desc_en:
•   0 = Initializing state
•   1 = UPM in shutdown state
•   2 = UPM in standby state
•   3 = UPM in online state
•   4 = UPM in ECT state
•   5 = UPM in suspended state
•   6 = UPM in HRS state
•   7 = UPM energize output command
•   8 = UPM in unknown state
•   9 = UPM in suspended state with rectifier on
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement d'état de l'UPM (0 initialisation, 1 arrêt, 2 veille, 3 online, 4 ECT, 5 suspendu, 6 HRS, 7 énergisation sortie, 8 inconnu, 9 suspendu redresseur actif).

events.name: Private rectifier state changed
events.desc_en:
•   0 = Init state
•   1 = Shutdown state
•   2 = Precharge state
•   3 = Normal state
•   4 = To battery state
•   5= On battery state
•   6 = From battery state
•   8 =Suspend state
•   9 = From suspend state
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement d'état du redresseur (0 init, 1 arrêt, 2 précharge, 3 normal, 4 vers batterie, 5 sur batterie, 6 depuis batterie, 8 suspendu, 9 depuis suspendu).

events.name: Private battery state changed
events.desc_en:
•   0 = Init
•   1 = Shutdown
•   2 = CC charge
•   3 = CV charge
•   4 = On boost
•   5 = Const power
•   6 = Trip
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement d'état de la batterie (0 init, 1 arrêt, 2 charge courant constant, 3 charge tension constante, 4 boost, 5 puissance constante, 6 déclenchement).

events.name: Private Sync state changed
events.desc_en:
•   0 = Output
•   1 = Input
•   2 = Internal can sync
•   3 = max
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement de source de synchronisation (0 sortie, 1 entrée, 2 sync CAN interne).

events.name: Private MCU communicating
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : la MCU communique.

events.name: Private MCU not communicating
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : la MCU ne communique plus.

events.name: Private Input Voltage Abnormal
events.desc_en:
No error code. This alarm indicates that input voltage sample larger than input peak
voltage + 20V. The input voltage is abnormal
events.desc_fr: Un échantillon de tension d'entrée dépasse la crête d'entrée + 20 V : tension d'entrée anormale.

events.name: Bypass AC Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension bypass trop haute : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Bypass AC Under Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension bypass trop basse : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Bypass Under / Over Frequency
events.desc_fr: Fréquence bypass hors limites.

events.name: Output AC Under/Over Voltage
events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie hors limites : transfert forcé vers bypass en mode online (195 = sous-tension, 196 = surtension).

events.name: Output Under / Over Frequency
events.desc_fr: Fréquence de sortie hors limites.

events.name: Output Voltage Abnormal

values.1: Autre unité sur bypass et pas de tension de sortie
values.2: Autre unité online et pas de tension de sortie
values.3: Aucune unité n'alimente la sortie mais tension détectée au démarrage
values.4: Aucune unité n'alimente la sortie mais tension détectée en veille

events.desc_fr: Tension de sortie anormale au démarrage : relais collé, SCR en court-circuit ou problème de communication parallèle.

events.name: Output Phase Rotation
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases de sortie inversé.

events.name: Remote Emergency Power Off
events.desc_fr: EPO distant : convertisseurs et charge coupés immédiatement.

events.name: Bypass Phase Rotation
events.desc_fr: Ordre des phases bypass inversé : transfert vers bypass interdit.

events.name: Bypass Not Available
events.desc_fr: Bypass indisponible (rotation, tension, fréquence ou défaut interrupteur statique) alors que le relais anti-retour est fermé.

events.name: Backfeed Switchgear Closed
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is activated when the backfeed relay or contactor is closed.
The backfeed switchgear auxiliary is connected to the interface board, which connects to
the PLD.
events.desc_fr: Le relais ou contacteur anti-retour est fermé.

events.name: Backfeed Switchgear Failed

values.3xxx: Anti-retour n'a pas ouvert en synchronisation alternative

error_code.note: Les 3 derniers chiffres donnent la phase (1 = A, 2 = B, 3 = C, 12 = A+B ...). Ex. 1001 = n'a pas ouvert phase A.

events.desc_fr: Défaut du ou des relais/contacteurs anti-retour.

events.name: Exit ESS Mode
events.desc_en:
Implemented as a bit field:
•  0x1 = Output overload level 2
•  0x2 = ESS frequency fault
•  0x4 = Bypass is not phase-locked
•  0x8 = Phase A UV fault
•  0x10 = Phase B UV fault
•  0x20 = Phase C UV fault
•  0x40 = Phase A OV fault
•  0x80 = Phase B OV fault
•  0x100 = Phase C OV fault
•  0x200 = Not used
•  0x400 = UPM cannot support ESS
•  0x800 = UPM online
•  0x1000 = *Other fault
•  0x2000 = Not used
•  0x4000 = Fault detection active
•  0x8000 = **Faults causing exit to bypass
* Faults that have node bits assigned for logging:
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_BYPASS_NOT_AVAILABLE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_STS_FAN_FAILED)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_OUTPUT_UNDER_OVER_FREQUENCY)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_BYPASS_SYNC_OUT_OF_RANGE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_OUTPUT_AC_UNDER_VOLTAGE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_OUTPUT_AC_OVER_VOLTAGE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_BYPASS_AC_UNDER_VOLTAGE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_BYPASS_AC_OVER_VOLTAGE)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_INTERNAL_CAN_ERROR)
• Overload level 3 or 4 and no NOT ENOUGH UPMS alarm
**Faults causing exit to bypass
• Another UPS has transferred to bypass and local MOB is closed
• RemotePowerOff active and UPS not redundant
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_ON_MANUAL_MAINTENANCE_BYPASS)
• Any unit bypassCmd active
• Battery breaker open
• Battery disconnected
• Battery switchgear open
• PowerConditionerMode
• BatteryStrings is set to zero
• Any UPM shutdownImminent and UPS not redundant
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_STATIC_SWITCH_SHORT)
• NB_GetNodebit(MCU_NB_NOT_ENOUGH_UPMS)
• ParallelETB
• External CAN Failed.
***Other Faults causing exit to online but won’t be recorded in error code:
• Other UPS online with MOB closed
• EPO activated
• BuildingInput RemoteLoadoff
• BuildingInput RemoteESSVMMSOff
• BuildingInput RemoteRectifierOff
• HighAlert
• Battery test or Battery discharging
• Any UPS on Generator
•   ESS not installed
•   ESS is not enabled and building input remote ESS is not on
•   MOBOpenOutputOff
•   ParallelForwardTransfer
•   24v or 5v power failure
events.desc_fr: Sortie du mode ESS (champ de bits des raisons : surcharge niveau 2, défaut de fréquence, bypass non verrouillé en phase, sous/surtension par phase, UPM online, autre défaut).

events.name: Bypass Hot
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether bypass input is
energized or not. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not impact the
actual UPS functionality.
events.desc_fr: Indique à la CSB si l'entrée bypass est sous tension ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Bypass Installed
events.desc_en:
No error code. Indicates whether bypass is installed or not. The default value is 0
(installed).
events.desc_fr: Indique si le bypass est installé.

events.name: MBS Installed
events.desc_en:
No error code. Indicates whether MBS is installed or not. The default value is 0 (not
installed).
events.desc_fr: Indique si le bypass de maintenance (MBS) est installé.

events.name: Battery Installed
events.desc_en:
No error code. Indicates whether the battery is installed or not. The status is based on a
parameter setting.
events.desc_fr: Indique si la batterie est installée.

events.name: MCU Software Incompatible

bits.0x0060: PLD firmware is not for this UPS

events.desc_en:
Incompatible firmware or incompatible PLD version detected:
• 0x001x = Machine ID on the interface board is incorrect for this firmware. The lowest 4
bits show the incorrect ID read from HW.
• 0x0020 = Incompatible PLD version
• 0x003x = Interface board revision is incorrect for this firmware. The lowest 4 bits show
the incorrect ID read from HW.
• 0x004x = PLD version is not for this interface. The lowest 4 bits show the incorrect ID
read from HW.
• 0x0050 = Board is not MCU
• 0x0060 = PLD firmware is not for this UPS
• 0x01yx = CAN communication versions incompatible, x = incompatible UPMs number,
y = 1 if CSB incompatible, otherwise 0.
events.desc_fr: Firmware ou PLD incompatible (ID machine, révision de carte, version PLD, versions CAN incompatibles).

events.name: UPS On Bypass
events.desc_en:
No error code. Load is powered from bypass. The status is suppressed in the ESS
mode.
events.desc_fr: La charge est alimentée par le bypass.

events.name: UPS Shutdown
events.desc_en: No error code. The MCU is in the shutdown state.
events.desc_fr: La MCU est à l'état arrêt.

events.name: ESS Active

bits.0x0004: Forward transfer to online due to short circuit
bits.0x0008: ESS is not enabled and building input remote ESS is not on
bits.0x0010: MOB open and MOB open output off
bits.0x0020: Another parallel MCU has changed to online and local MOB is not open
bits.0x0080: Parallel Forward transfer if other MCU has told to forward transfer due to
bits.0x0100: Internal and external parallel : How much UPM power is switching off vs how
bits.0x0800: Battery conditions not ok for suspend
bits.0x1000: Remote building input ESS / VMMS off

events.desc_en:
The UPS is in the ESS mode. This requires that ESS is installed and has been enabled
by the user. The state is activated whenever the UPS state changes to the ESS mode
and deactivated when the state changes from the ESS mode to something else. See the
Behavioral specification for more information.
• 0x0001: User commanded transfer
• 0x0002: Temporarily leave ESS
– Rectifier not on suspend mode or rectifier state changing while battery on boost.
– While on ABM cycle when ABM transfers from rest to Charge the charging current
might not reach necessary levels.
• 0x0004: Forward transfer to online due to short circuit
• 0x0008: ESS is not enabled and building input remote ESS is not on
• 0x0010: MOB open and MOB open output off
• 0x0020: Another parallel MCU has changed to online and local MOB is not open
• 0x0040: High alert
• 0x0080: Parallel Forward transfer if other MCU has told to forward transfer due to
short circuit
• 0x0100: Internal and external parallel : How much UPM power is switching off vs how
much redundant capacity is available
• 0x0400: Building input load off
• 0x0800: Battery conditions not ok for suspend
• 0x1000: Remote building input ESS / VMMS off
• 0x2000: Building input on generator
• 0x4000: Nodebit Boost charge active
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est en mode ESS (nécessite ESS installé et activé).

events.name: UPS System Online
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPS is in the online mode. This status is activated whenever the
UPS state changes to the online mode and deactivated when the state changes from the
online mode to something else. See the Behavioral specification for more information.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est en mode online (double conversion).

events.name: UPS On Battery
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPS load is powered from battery. This status is suppressed during
battery test.
events.desc_fr: La charge est alimentée par la batterie.

events.name: On MBS, Battery
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, battery.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), charge sur batterie.

events.name: On MBS, Unit Online
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, online.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), unité online.

events.name: On MBS, On Bypass
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, on bypass.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), sur bypass.

events.name: On MBS, Shutdown
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, shutdown.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), à l'arrêt.

events.name: UPS On Generator
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPS is in the on generator mode. This mode is activated when a
signal input (building input) configured for "On generator" goes active.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS fonctionne sur groupe électrogène (entrée de signal configurée "On generator").

events.name: To Bypass Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The MCU has received an external command to transfer to bypass.
events.desc_fr: Commande « To Bypass Command » reçue.

events.name: UPS Normal Command
events.desc_en:
No error code. A normal command has been received by the MCU. When it is received, it
is logged in the history. When a command packet is received, it is buffered and
processed and queued by the 100-ms task. Sticky alarms are reset when this command
is activated. When the command is activated, it remains active and is reset when any of
the following occur:
• MCU system machine state is transferred to shutdown
• MCU system state is shutdown or syncing and the Remote Emergency Power Off
alarm is active
• Load Off command is received
• UPS Off command is received
• Normal command is received
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPS Normal Command » reçue.

events.name: Load Off Command
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPS has received a command for load off. When it is received, it is
logged in the history. When a command packet is received, it is buffered and processed
and queued by the 100-ms task. Sticky alarms are reset when this command is
activated. The command is cleared when the following occur:
• MCU system machine state is the shutdown state
• Normal command is entered
• UPS On command is entered
events.desc_fr: Commande « Load Off Command » reçue.

events.name: Static Switch Short
events.desc_fr: Courant trop élevé dans l'interrupteur statique alors qu'il n'est pas commandé.

events.name: ESS Installed
events.desc_en:
No error code. The unit has the ESS mode installed. It can be commanded to the ESS
mode.
events.desc_fr: Le mode ESS est installé et peut être commandé.

events.name: ESS Enabled
events.desc_en:
No error code. Set if the ESS mode is enabled (enable command is given from the
display).
When enabled, the unit can enter the ESS mode.
events.desc_fr: Le mode ESS est activé (commande donnée depuis l'afficheur).

events.name: VMMS Installed
events.desc_en: No error code. The VMMS is installed. The system can be in VMMS.
events.desc_fr: VMMS installé.

events.name: VMMS Enabled
events.desc_en:
No error code. Set if VMMS is enabled (enable-command given from front panel). This
means the system transfers to VMMS when conditions allow.
events.desc_fr: VMMS activé : le système y transfère quand les conditions le permettent.

events.name: VMMS Active
events.desc_en: No error code. Set if the UPS is in the VMSS mode.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est en mode VMMS.

events.name: ABM Installed
events.desc_en: No error code. The ABM is installed.
events.desc_fr: ABM (gestion avancée de batterie) installé.

events.name: ABM Enable
events.desc_en: No error code. The ABM is enabled and can be activated.
events.desc_fr: ABM activé et activable.

events.name: ABM Active
events.desc_en: No error code. Set if ABM is active.
events.desc_fr: ABM actif.

events.name: System Not Redundant
events.timing: Not yet | Not yet | Not yet | None
events.desc_en:
No error code. A parallel system configured for redundancy is operating in the capacity
mode.
events.desc_fr: Système parallèle configuré en redondance fonctionnant en mode capacité.

events.name: Pull Chain
events.desc_en:
No error code. In an internal or external parallel system, indicates that one or more UPSs
has transferred to bypass in the presence of a CAN bus failure. The notice is suppressed
when a CAN bus failure is not active or during the inverter startup state. The unit
transfers to the bypass state when the pull chain is active.
events.desc_fr: En parallèle, une ou plusieurs UPS ont transféré sur bypass en présence d'un défaut CAN (pull chain active).

events.name: Check Pull Chain
events.desc_en:
No error code. Indicates that the pull chain is being pulled low when one or more MCUs
are not on bypass, or that the pull chain is floating high when one or more MCUs are on
bypass. If an external CAN communication error and pull chain bus is active while this
UPS is not on bypass, it should not be activated. The alarm is not monitored during the
inverter startup state when the pull chain signal is temporarily used for other purposes.
The bypass status is based on CAN communication. See Behavioral specification for
details on inverter start.
events.desc_fr: Pull chain tirée au niveau bas alors qu'une MCU n'est pas sur bypass, ou flottante au niveau haut alors qu'une MCU est sur bypass.

events.name: Output Hot
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether output is energized
or not. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not impact the actual
UPS functionality.
events.desc_fr: Indique à la CSB si la sortie est sous tension ; n'agit que sur l'affichage.

events.name: Shutdown Imminent
events.timing: Not yet | Not yet | Not yet | All
events.desc_en:
No error code. Load power off warning. The UPS is about to shut down the load.
Shutdown Imminent is triggered when in the overload condition and bypass is
unavailable.
events.desc_fr: Avertissement de coupure imminente de la charge (limite batterie atteinte, ou surcharge sans bypass disponible).

events.name: UPS Ready
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is in the Ready state.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est à l'état prêt.

events.name: MCU Configuration Error

bits.0x80: Échec de configuration parallèle : MyUPSNumber > max ou numéros dupliqués (effaçable par reset des alarmes après correction)
bits.0x200: Détection automatique de fréquence en cours (nécessite le bypass)
bits.0x1000: Configuration EEP incohérente avec le matériel (EEP 5 'STSkVA')
bits.0x4000: Compensation de puissance réactive ESS mal configurée
bits.0x8000: Une ou plusieurs UPS en parallèle externe ont une puissance différente

events.desc_fr: Erreur de configuration de la MCU.

events.name: MCU EEPROM Checksum Failed

error_code.note: Un bit par section en échec

events.desc_fr: Échec de checksum EEPROM de la MCU : démarrage interdit.

events.name: Emergency Transfer To Bypass
events.desc_fr: La charge était sur l'onduleur et a été transférée automatiquement sur bypass à cause d'une condition d'alarme.

events.name: UPS Phase A/B/C Output Overload (niveaux 1-4)
events.desc_fr: 242-244 : surcharge de base ; 245-247 : niveau 2 ; 248-250 : niveau 3 ; 251-253 : niveau 4 (par phase A/B/C).

events.name: MCU 5V / 24V Power Supply Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut d'alimentation logique MCU (254 = 5 V, 255 = 24 V). Tolérance ±15 %.

events.name: VMMS Not Available

bits.0x0002: System load too high for VMMS
bits.0x0004: Not enough UPMs to support load (Global required UPMs calculation failed)
bits.0x0040: Battery conditions not ok for VMMS (test underway, disconnected …)
bits.0x0400: A UPM has autonomously transferred online (output voltage dipped too low)
bits.0x1000: UPS is on battery because of utility UV
bits.0x4000: VMMS Onset timer has not expired (90 sec)
bits.0x8000: All parallel UPSs not available for VMMS

events.desc_en:
• 0x0001: Check VMMS EEPROM settings (Limit, Hysteresis)
• 0x0002: System load too high for VMMS
• 0x0004: Not enough UPMs to support load (Global required UPMs calculation failed)
• 0x0005: System wide UPM distribution failed
• 0x0006: Local UPM distribution failed
The rest of the error codes are implemented as a bit field.
• 0x0008: Remote ESS/VMMS off command
• 0x0010: High alert is active
• 0x0020: System is on generator
• 0x0040: Battery conditions not ok for VMMS (test underway, disconnected …)
• 0x0080*: UPM SuspendNotAvailable bit set. (* See explanation in ESS Not Available
event)
• 0x0100: External CAN failure
• 0x0200: Internal CAN failure
• 0x0400: A UPM has autonomously transferred online (output voltage dipped too low)
• 0x0800: A UPM reported overload
• 0x1000: UPS is on battery because of utility UV
• 0x2000: (Unused)
• 0x4000: VMMS Onset timer has not expired (90 sec)
• 0x8000: All parallel UPSs not available for VMMS
events.desc_fr: VMMS indisponible (valeurs : réglages EEPROM, charge trop élevée, pas assez d'UPM ; bits : commande distante, alerte haute, sur groupe, batterie, défauts CAN, surcharge...).

events.name: ECT Command
events.desc_en: No error code. The MCU received an ECT command.
events.desc_fr: Commande « ECT Command » reçue.

events.name: Parallel Setup Failure
events.desc_en: Failed parameter number.
events.desc_fr: Échec de configuration parallèle : le code donne le numéro du paramètre en cause.

events.name: System Test In Progress
events.desc_en:
•   1 = Performing ECT
•   2 = Performing parallel auto-calibration
events.desc_fr: Test système en cours (1 = ECT, 2 = auto-calibration parallèle).

events.name: On Battery LED Is Lit
events.desc_en:
No error code. The yellow battery LED is lit, indicating that the UPS load is powered on
battery.
events.desc_fr: LED jaune batterie allumée : charge sur batterie.

events.name: On Bypass LED Is Lit
events.desc_en: No error code. The yellow bypass LED is lit, indicating that the UPS is on bypass.
events.desc_fr: LED jaune bypass allumée : UPS sur bypass.

events.name: On Line LED Is Lit
events.desc_en:
No error code. The green online LED is lit, indicating that the UPS load is protected. The
UPS can be on the inverter or in the ESS mode. This LED is also lit when the battery
LED is lit.
events.desc_fr: LED verte online allumée : charge protégée.

events.name: Automatic Start Up Pending
events.desc_en:
No error code. The UPS has shut down on low battery and automatic restart is pending.
Auto restart happens when the input returns and the battery totally discharged alarm is
cleared.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS s'est arrêtée sur batterie épuisée ; le redémarrage automatique est en attente du retour du réseau.

events.name: Ground / Site Wiring Fault
events.desc_fr: Tension neutre-terre excessive.

events.name: External CAN Abnormal or Configuration Mismatch

bits.0x0001: Une ou plusieurs UPS du bus CAN ne communiquent plus
bits.0x0002: Nombre d'UPS sur le bus < paramètre EEPROM 5008
bits.0x0004: Aucun paquet CAN émis depuis ≥ 1 s
bits.0x0008: Aucun paquet CAN reçu depuis ≥ 1 s
bits.0x0010: Contrôleur CAN en mode error passive

events.desc_fr: Erreur CAN externe : matériel, câblage ou configuration incorrecte (systèmes parallèles).

events.name: SPI Bus Failed

bits.0x0001: EEPROM SPI BUS failed or I/O Expander Failed at power-up

events.desc_en:
There was a problem with the SPI bus in the unit, as described by the error code:
• 0x0001 = EEPROM SPI BUS failed or I/O Expander Failed at power-up
• 0x0002 = PLD SPI BUS failed
• 0x0004 = I/O expander SPI BUS failed
events.desc_fr: Problème de bus SPI dans le module.

events.name: Output Sync Out of Range
events.desc_en:
No error code. The output frequency measured by the MCU has become unqualified for
the purposes of synchronization.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence de sortie mesurée par la MCU n'est plus qualifiée pour la synchronisation.

events.name: Bypass Sync Out of Range
events.desc_en:
No error code. The single-phase bypass frequency measured by the MCU has become
unqualified for the purposes of synchronization.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence bypass monophasée mesurée par la MCU n'est plus qualifiée pour la synchronisation.

events.name: Input Sync Out of Range
events.desc_en:
No error code. The input frequency measured by the MCU has become unqualified for
the purposes of synchronization.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence d'entrée n'est plus qualifiée pour la synchronisation.

events.name: System On Maintenance Bypass

values.2: Internal maintenance bypass switch active. The internal MBS is connected to

events.desc_en:
Indicates whether MBS is active or not. The error code tells the source of the
maintenance bypass command.
• 1 = Forced maintenance signal input active
• 2 = Internal maintenance bypass switch active. The internal MBS is connected to
GET_MBS_FB1/2 and must be enabled in parameters.
events.desc_fr: Le bypass de maintenance (MBS) est actif (1 = entrée de maintenance forcée, 2 = MBS interne).

events.name: Not enough UPMs

values.1: Pas de tension de sortie après commande d'énergisation (appareillage onduleur n'a pas ouvert ?)
values.2: Redémarrage auto en cours mais tous les UPM ne sont pas prêts
values.6: Puissance UPM disponible insuffisante pour passer online (trop de charge, ou MinReqkVA, alarmes/config UPM)
values.7: Aucun UPM online après commande (perte d'accord avec la tension de sortie ?)
values.8: Pas assez d'UPM disponibles en ESS

events.desc_fr: Pas assez d'UPM disponibles pour supporter la charge.

events.name: Not Enough Bypass Capacity
events.desc_fr: Capacité du bypass insuffisante.

events.name: UPS System Off
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is off, distributed parallel system is off.
events.desc_fr: UPS arrêté, système parallèle distribué arrêté.

events.name: Single UPS System
events.desc_en: No error code. This is a single UPS system (only one UPM).
events.desc_fr: Système à un seul UPM.

events.name: Internal Redundant System
events.desc_en: No error code. This is an internal redundant system (more than one UPM in one UPS).
events.desc_fr: Système redondant interne (plusieurs UPM dans une UPS).

events.name: Distributed Parallel System
events.desc_en: No error code. This is a distributed parallel system.
events.desc_fr: Système parallèle distribué.

events.name: Bypass Breaker Installed
events.desc_en:
No error code. A bypass breaker is installed. This status is not yet implemented. It is
reserved for possible future use.
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur bypass installé (réservé, non implémenté).

events.name: Bypass Breaker Active
events.desc_en:
No error code. The bypass breaker is active. This status is not yet implemented. It is
reserved for possible future use.
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur bypass actif (réservé, non implémenté).

events.name: MOB open
events.desc_en: No error code. The MOB is opened.
events.desc_fr: Le disjoncteur de sortie du module (MOB) est ouvert.

events.name: Static Switch Active
events.desc_en: No error code. The static switch is active. The UPS is on bypass or in the ESS mode.
events.desc_fr: L'interrupteur statique est actif : UPS sur bypass ou en ESS.

events.name: HRS Installed
events.desc_en: No error code. The unit supports HRS.
events.desc_fr: L'unité supporte le mode HRS.

events.name: HRS Enable
events.desc_en: No error code. HRS is enabled and can be activated.
events.desc_fr: HRS activé et activable.

events.name: HRS Active
events.desc_en: No error code. HRS is active.
events.desc_fr: HRS actif.

events.name: Too Many Inverter Transfers

values.1: Trop de transferts onduleur (verrouillé 1 h sur bypass après 3 transferts d'urgence en 10 min)
values.2: Détection d'orage (mode ESS désactivé un temps défini)

events.desc_fr: Trop de transferts onduleur / orage.

events.name: Output not in sync with bypass
events.desc_en:
No error code. The output voltage is not in phase sync with bypass and output voltage is
present.
events.desc_fr: La tension de sortie n'est pas en phase avec le bypass alors qu'elle est présente.

events.name: Output not in sync with ext sync
events.desc_en:
No error code. The output voltage is not in phase sync with the external sync and output
voltage is present.
events.desc_fr: La tension de sortie n'est pas en phase avec la synchronisation externe alors qu'elle est présente.

events.name: STS Fan Failed

values.4: Au moins un ventilateur STS ou cheminée en défaut (seul code valide en 93PM 100-500 kVA ; codes 1-3 non valides)

events.desc_fr: Défaut de ventilateur de l'interrupteur statique.

events.name: MCU Control Power
events.timing: N/A set at | N/A | N/A | When

Other than 0 if reset was caused by a firmware event. The status is logged after
processor initialization is complete.
events.desc_fr: Journalisé après l'initialisation du processeur MCU (code ≠ 0 : reset dû au firmware).

events.name: Bypass Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Surtempérature mesurée sur la plaque de montage des SCR.

events.name: MIS Installed
events.timing: Always false | Always false | Always false | None
events.desc_en: No error code. Indicates whether an MIS is installed or not. The status is always false.
events.desc_fr: Indique si un MIS est installé (toujours faux).

events.name: MIS Open/ Closed
events.desc_en: No error code. Indicates whether the MIS is open or not.
events.desc_fr: Indique si le MIS/contacteur onduleur est ouvert ou fermé.

events.name: UPS Starting
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is starting (going to the online state).
events.desc_fr: L'UPS démarre (passage à l'état online).

events.name: Command Received
events.desc_en:
A new command sent by the CSB has been received by the MCU. Command number:
• 1 = Online
• 2 = Bypass
• 3 = Shutdown
• 4 = Go to battery
• 5 = Stop battery mode
• 6 = Start ECT
• 7 = Stop ECT
• 8 = Charger on
• 9 = Charger off
• 10 = Start battery test
• 11 = Stop battery test
• 12 = Enable UPM service mode
• 13 = Disable UPM service mode
• 14 = Start UPM test
• 15 = Disable ESS
• 16 = Enable ESS
• 17 = Disable VMMS
• 18 = Enable VMMS
• 19 = Disable HRS
• 20 = Enable HRS
• 21 = Disable ABM
• 22 = Enable ABM
• 23 = Reset alarms
• 24 = Reset status
• 25 = Reset history log
• 26 = Reset battery log
events.desc_fr: Commande « Command Received » reçue.

events.name: On MBS, Ready
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, Ready.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), prête.

events.name: On MBS, Starting
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, Starting.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), en démarrage.

events.name: Load Power Off
events.desc_en:
No error code. The load was shut down. This status is not active at startup when the
UPS has not been commanded on yet, and is not active if the UPS is commanded off or
turns off due to EPO or low battery shutdown. That is, this status signifies an abnormal
shutdown.
events.desc_fr: La charge a été coupée de façon anormale (pas sur commande, EPO ou batterie basse).

events.name: On MBS, ESS Active
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, ESS active.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), ESS actif.

events.name: On MBS, VMMS Active
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, VMMS active.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), VMMS actif.

events.name: On MBS, HRS Active
events.desc_en: No error code. The UPS is on MBS, HRS active.
events.desc_fr: L'UPS est sur le bypass de maintenance (MBS), HRS actif.

events.name: STS / Chimney Ambient Over Temperature
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante élevée (301 = STS/MCU, 303 = cheminée).

events.name: Output overload trip
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Déclenchement sur surcharge de sortie.

events.name: Chimney Fan / Fan Power Board Cool Fan Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut de ventilateur cheminée (304) ou carte alimentation ventilateurs (305). Détection invalide si l'alimentation de la carte est coupée.

events.name: UPS Exit ECT Process

bits.0x1000: Electronic load failed to start up (only possible when configured as electronic
bits.0x2000: Electronic load shut down unexpectedly (only possible when configured as

events.desc_en:
This code is implemented as a bit field. Several error conditions can be active at the
same time:
• 0x01 = Enter ECT mode timeout
• 0x02 = ECT command is cleared
• 0x04 = Any UPM exit ECT mode
• 0x08 = Bypass not available
• 0x10 = Building input remote load off
• 0x20 = Output Overload
• 0x40 = EPO or bypass over temperature
• 0x1000 = Electronic load failed to start up (only possible when configured as electronic
load)
• 0x2000 = Electronic load shut down unexpectedly (only possible when configured as
electronic load)
events.desc_fr: Sortie du processus ECT (bits : temporisation, commande annulée, UPM sorti d'ECT, bypass indisponible, charge distante coupée, surcharge, EPO ou surtempérature bypass).

events.name: ESS Not Available

bits.0x4: Battery not OK for ESS transfer
bits.0x400: A UPM is in the ABM reset state

events.desc_en:
Implemented as a bit field:
•  0x1 = High Alert (storm detection)
•  0x2 = Remote ESS Off is active
•  0x4 = Battery not OK for ESS transfer
•  0x8 = Internal communication failure
•  0x10 = On generator (building input)
•  0x20*= UPM SuspendNotAvailable bit set
•  0x40 = Remote rectifier off active
•  0x80 = Overload level 2 on output
•  0x100 = ESS frequency fault
•  0x200 = Not phase locked to bypass
•  0x400 = A UPM is in the ABM reset state
•  0x0800 = ESS UV fault
•  0x1000 = ESS OV fault
•  0x2000 = Online timer has not expired
•  0x4000 = External CAN failure
*Error code 32 (0x20): The UPM SuspendNotAvailable bit can be set because the DC
link voltage prediction is too low or because the DC link voltage dipped too low when is
suspend mode. The DC link voltage prediction can be too low if the input voltage is too
low, or because the battery charging current is too high for the input voltage.
events.desc_fr: ESS indisponible (bits : alerte haute, ESS distant off, batterie, communication, groupe, UPM suspendu indisponible, surcharge niveau 2, défaut de fréquence, bypass non verrouillé, tension, temporisation, CAN externe).

events.name: High Alert
events.desc_en: No error code. ESS High Alert is active.
events.desc_fr: Alerte haute ESS active (détection d'orage).

events.name: Frequency Auto Detected
events.desc_en:
The detected frequency.
• 50 = 50 Hz
• 60 = 60 Hz
Auto-frequency detection is finished and the nominal frequency has been automatically
detected as either 50 or 60 Hz.
events.desc_fr: La fréquence nominale (50 ou 60 Hz) a été détectée automatiquement.

events.name: Internal CAN Bus Failed

bits.0x0001: Un ou plusieurs UPM ne communiquent plus
bits.0x0002: Nombre d'UPM sur le bus < paramètre EEPROM 502
bits.0x0100: Défaut CAN avec hot swap activé
bits.0x0200: Défaut CAN avec hot swap activé

events.desc_fr: Défaut du bus CAN interne.

events.name: System Overload
events.desc_fr: Niveau de surcharge système (parallèle) dépassé : alarme seule, sans effet sur le comportement.

events.name: System On Bypass
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether UPS/UPM level
online commands are enabled. The status affects what is shown on the display but does
not impact the actual UPS functionality.
events.desc_fr: Utilisé par la CSB pour l'affichage des commandes online ; sans effet fonctionnel.

events.name: UPS Not Redundant
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether UPS level shutdown
com- mands are enabled. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not
impact the actual UPS functionality.
events.desc_fr: Utilisé par la CSB pour l'affichage des commandes d'arrêt UPS ; sans effet fonctionnel.

events.name: UPMs Not Redundant
events.desc_en:
No error code. This status is used by the CSB to determine whether UPM level shutdown
commands are enabled. The status affects what is shown on the display but does not
impact the actual UPS functionality.
events.desc_fr: Utilisé par la CSB pour l'affichage des commandes d'arrêt UPM ; sans effet fonctionnel.

events.name: Bypass Service Button On
events.desc_en:
No error code. A button to let UPS transfer to bypass mode when bypass is available if
the HMI control is disabled.
events.desc_fr: Bouton de service forçant le transfert sur bypass (commande HMI désactivée).

events.name: Parameter Match Failed
events.manual_note: Le code d'erreur donne l'adresse du premier paramètre en écart.
events.desc_fr: Écart entre paramètres partagés externes : le système ne peut plus passer online (reste online/bypass s'il y est). Corriger l'EEP en écart, puis reset alarmes depuis le HMI.

events.name: Alternate Sync (Sync Box)
events.desc_en:
This status is used by the CSB to determine whether MCU is syncing to an external sync
reference.
events.desc_fr: La MCU se synchronise sur une référence externe (Sync Box).

events.name: Alternate Sync Error
events.desc_en:
External reference has the same limits as Bypass for voltage and frequency.
• 1 = External Reference OV
• 2 = External Reference UV
• 3 = 2 and 1 error code
• 4 = External Reference Phase Rotated
• 5 = 4 and 1 error code
• 6 = 4 and 2 error code
• 7 = 4, 2, and 1 error code
• 8 = External Reference UOF
• 9 -15 follow the same binary pattern
events.desc_fr: Erreur de la référence de synchronisation externe (1 = surtension, 2 = sous-tension, 4 = rotation de phase, 8 = fréquence, combinables).

events.name: Bypass Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Bypass over temperature trip can be enabled/disabled by MCU EEP 232. Default is
disabled. If enabled, the trip limit is defined in MCU EEP 233 with a default value of 88
degrees C.
events.desc_fr: Arrêt sur surtempérature du bypass (activable par EEP 232 ; limite EEP 233, 88 °C par défaut).

events.name: UPM hardware ID Mismatching
events.desc_fr: L'ID matériel d'un UPM ne correspond pas à celui de la MCU.

events.name: Auto calibration in progress

values.2: Legacy reactive current and sum power calibration
values.3: Only inverter voltage calibration by RMS current, no load

events.desc_en:
• 0: Unspecified autocal
• 1: Only reset autocal
• 2: Legacy reactive current and sum power calibration
• 3: Only inverter voltage calibration by RMS current, no load
• 4: Only inverter voltage without load
This node bit indicate auto calibration is processing. This is for 93PS and not
implemented in 93PM yet.
events.desc_fr: Auto-calibration en cours (93PS ; non implémenté en 93PM).

events.name: Battery Breaker Open/ Closed
events.desc_en:
Separate battery with 2 UPMs:
• 1 = UPM1 battery breaker open.
• 2 = UPM2 battery breaker open.
• 3 = UPM1 and UPM2 battery breakers open.
Otherwise (common battery or single UPM unit):
For 20 kVA frame:
• 1 = Internal battery breaker open
• 2 = External battery breaker open
• 3 = Both breakers open
For 40 kVA frame:
• Either internal or external or both open.
Indicates that the battery breaker is open or closed. Breaker auxiliary contact feedback
indicates battery breaker is open. Battery breaker can be operated by user, or when
there is an EPO trip, the breaker is triggered to open.
This nodebit is only for 93PS and not implemented in 93PM yet. 93PM use UPM0 for
battery breaker open alarm. 93PS supports hot swap, battery open alarm is moved to
MCU. UPM does not report breaker open alarm in 93PS UPM.
events.desc_fr: Disjoncteur batterie ouvert (retour contact auxiliaire). Peut être ouvert par l'utilisateur ou par un déclenchement EPO.

events.name: Not Enough Redundant UPMs
events.desc_fr: Le nombre d'UPM redondants est inférieur au niveau de redondance réglé (EEP 235).

events.name: Transformer Fan Failed
events.desc_en:
No error code. A transformer fan failure is detected. This alarm is used in 9PHD only and
it is disabled by default.
events.desc_fr: Défaut ventilateur transformateur (9PHD uniquement, désactivé par défaut).

events.name: Transformer Over Temperature Trip
events.desc_en:
No error code. The “Transformer Over Temperature” signal input has been active for a
period of time exceeding the delay defined by MCU EEP 154 (parameter address 5154).
The alarm will cause the UPS to shut down and the UPS will not start up again until the
alarm is cleared by the user. This alarm is used in 9PHD only and it is disabled by
default.
events.desc_fr: Surtempérature transformateur : arrêt de l'UPS (9PHD uniquement, désactivé par défaut).

events.name: Adaptive Overload Capacity Off

bits.0x0010: Any Parallel UPS AOL is off

events.desc_en:
•   0x0001: ESS enabled
•   0x0002: UPM AOL capacity off
•   0x0004: External CAN error
•   0x0008: Internal CAN error
•   0x0010: Any Parallel UPS AOL is off
events.desc_fr: Capacité de surcharge adaptative désactivée (défaut CAN, température ambiante élevée, batterie déconnectée, fonctionnement sur batterie, défaut ventilateur, ESS...).

events.name: Boost Charging Available
events.desc_en:
No error code. Boost charging is available and “Start Boost Charge” commands are
allowed.
events.desc_fr: La charge boost est disponible et les commandes « Start Boost Charge » sont permises.

events.name: Boost Charging Active
events.desc_en:
No error code. Boost charging is ongoing.
Reserved      Reserved MCU NB 329 for 93PR.
MCU NB
329
events.desc_fr: Charge boost en cours.

events.name: Boost Charging Installed
events.desc_en: No error code. Boost charging is supported.
events.desc_fr: La charge boost est supportée.

events.name: Ambient Temperature Changed
events.desc_en: Error code: Temperature in °C, negative values in two’s complement.
events.desc_fr: Température ambiante modifiée ; le code donne la température en °C (complément à deux si négative).

events.name: Check Battery Ambient Temperature
events.desc_en:
No error code. Battery ambient temperature has been over EEP-configured temperature
threshold for EEP-configured time. Activation of this notice can be disabled by writing
EEP 5239 to 0.
events.desc_fr: La température ambiante batterie dépasse le seuil EEP depuis plus longtemps que le délai EEP (désactivable avec EEP 5239 = 0).

events.name: MCU Demand Response Unavailable

bits.0x0200: ABM master not ready for DR

events.desc_en:
•0x0001: Demand response mode not set
•0x0002: Regulation mode not set
•0x0004: MCU not online
•0x0008: External CAN error
•0x0010: Internal CAN error
•0x0020: UPMs not ready
•0x0040: On generator
•0x0080: System overload
•0x0100: Utility frequency unstable
•0x0200: ABM master not ready for DR
MCU demand response unavailable.
events.desc_fr: Réponse à la demande indisponible au niveau MCU (mode non réglé, défaut CAN, UPM non prêts, groupe, surcharge, fréquence instable...).

events.name: MCU Demand Response Active
events.desc_en: No error code. MCU is on demand response mode.
events.desc_fr: La MCU est en mode réponse à la demande.

events.name: Utility Frequency Unstable
events.desc_en:
•   1: Under frequency
•   2: Over frequency
•   3: RoCo frequency
events.desc_fr: Fréquence réseau instable (1 = sous-fréquence, 2 = sur-fréquence, 3 = variation rapide RoCoF).

events.name: SSM Unlock
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Verrouillage SSM levé.

events.name: Switch Cabinet Fan Failed
events.desc_fr: Défaut de ventilateur d'armoire de commutation (détection activable via EEP165).

events.name: MCU 24V STS Power Supply Failed
events.desc_fr: Alimentation 24 V du STS en défaut.

events.name: ABM State Changed
events.desc_en:
•   1: Reset
•   2: Charge
•   3: Float
•   4: Rest
•   5: Discharge
•   6: Battery test
•   7: Demand response
events.desc_fr: Changement d'état ABM (1 reset, 2 charge, 3 float, 4 repos, 5 décharge, 6 test batterie, 7 réponse à la demande).

events.name: Battery HMI status changed
events.desc_en:
•   2: Testing
•   3: Discharging
•   4: Charging
•   5: Resting
events.desc_fr: Statut batterie affiché au HMI modifié (2 test, 3 décharge, 4 charge, 5 repos).

events.name: Fan Speed Error
events.desc_en:
•   1: Fan number one error
•   2: Fan number two error
•   3: Fan number three error
events.desc_fr: Vitesse de ventilateur anormale.

events.name: ESS Disabled Due to High Battery
events.desc_en:
No error code.
Voltage
events.desc_fr: ESS désactivé à cause d'une tension batterie élevée.

events.name: Battery Rest Time Failure
events.desc_fr: En état ABM Rest, la tension batterie baisse trop vite : maintenance batterie nécessaire.

events.name: I2C Fail
events.desc_fr: Module I2C en échec. Si l'erreur persiste plus d'une minute, la MCU doit être redémarrée.

events.name: Internal CAN traffic Jam
events.desc_fr: Nombre de resets du CAN interne dus à un engorgement. Réinitialisé à l'effacement des alarmes sticky.

events.name: MCU EEPROMs Not Synced
events.desc_fr: Les sections EEPROM à synchroniser (3 et 5) de la MCU et de l'UPM ont des checksums différents.

events.name: MCU State Changed
events.desc_en:
•   0: Initialization state
•   1: Load off
•   2: Bypass
•   3: Online
•   4: ESS
•   5: ECT
•   6: Energize Output
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement d'état de la MCU (0 initialisation, 1 charge coupée, 2 bypass, 3 online, 4 ESS, 5 ECT, 6 énergisation de sortie).

events.name: Sync state changed
events.desc_en: Indicates UPM number that is changing Sync master
events.desc_fr: Journal local : changement de maître de synchronisation (numéro d'UPM).

events.name: UPM communicating
events.desc_en: Indicates UPM number.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : l'UPM indiqué communique.

events.name: UPM not communicating
events.desc_en: Indicates UPM number.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : l'UPM indiqué ne communique plus.

events.name: CSB communicating
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : la CSB communique.

events.name: CSB not communicating
events.desc_en: No error code.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : la CSB ne communique plus.

events.name: Request cleared
events.desc_en: Indicates UPM number.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : demande effacée (numéro d'UPM).

events.name: Invalid UPM state
events.desc_en: Indicates UPM number.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : état UPM invalide (numéro d'UPM).

events.name: Inverter inhibited counter
events.desc_en: 1-3 counts.
events.desc_fr: Journal local : compteur d'inhibition onduleur (1 à 3).

events.name: Online command
events.desc_en:
Source of the command:
• 1 = Entered from the display
• 2 = Remote command
Online mode command is issued from the CSB.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Online command » émise depuis la CSB. Source : 1 = afficheur, 2 = commande distante.

events.name: Bypass command

Source of the command:
• 1 = Entered from the display
• 2 = Remote command
A bypass command is issued from the CSB.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Bypass command » émise depuis la CSB. Source : 1 = afficheur, 2 = commande distante.

events.name: Load Off Command

values.1: UPS shutdown command from the debugger

events.desc_en:
Source of the command:
• 1 = UPS shutdown command from the debugger
• 2 = UPS shutdown command
• 3 = UPM shutdown command

A load off command is issued from the CSB.
events.desc_fr: Commande « Load Off Command » émise depuis la CSB. Source : 1 = afficheur, 2 = commande distante.

events.name: UPM On Command
events.desc_en: UPM number. A normal mode command is issued from the CSB.
events.desc_fr: Commande « UPM On Command » reçue.

events.name: Signal Input Remote UPS On

0x0002 = input2
0x0004 = input3
0x0080 = input8

Conversion Command”).

events.name: Signal Input Remote Go To Bypass
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x0001 = input1
0x0002 = input2
0x0004 = input3
0x0080 = input8
0x0100 = input9
A signal input is active and configured as “Remote go to Bypass”.
events.desc_fr: Une entrée de signal (building input) est active et configurée en « Remote go to Bypass ». Le code d'erreur indique quelles entrées (bit 0x0001 = entrée 1 ... 0x0100 = entrée 9).

events.name: Signal Input Remote Load Off
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x0001 = input1
0x0002 = input2
0x0004 = input3
0x0080 = input8
0x0100 = input9
A signal input is active and configured as “Remote Load Off”.
events.desc_fr: Une entrée de signal (building input) est active et configurée en « Remote Load Off ». Le code d'erreur indique quelles entrées (bit 0x0001 = entrée 1 ... 0x0100 = entrée 9).

events.name: Signal Input Remote Power Module Off
events.desc_en:
Error code:
0x0001 = input1
0x0002 = input2
0x0004 = input3
0x0080 = input8
